key_provisions_or_claims: Over 40 education ministers met online on 25 May 2023 on generative AI in education.
Survey of 450+ institutions found under 10% have formal guidance on generative AI.
UNESCO is developing policy guidelines on generative AI in education and research.
UNESCO is developing AI competency frameworks for students and teachers.
The UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI is cited as the normative framework.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news release on the first global meeting of education ministers (25 May 2023) on generative AI such as ChatGPT. It reports a survey showing under 10% of institutions have formal AI guidance, and announces forthcoming UNESCO policy guidelines and AI competency frameworks, grounded in its Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
annotation.title_clean: AI: UNESCO mobilizes education ministers from around the world for a co-ordinated response to ChatGPT
annotation.title_en: AI: UNESCO mobilizes education ministers from around the world for a co-ordinated response to ChatGPT
